'''2001 Normal DPC Yannick Lapointe DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech after playing it at [[2001 Normal DPC]]. The post says 'this is the deck i have used at the DPC'; it gives no record or placing. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-14151">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14151 DeckTech post 14151], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 1 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14151/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14151/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018041618/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14151/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
